title: 039 NNPredict improvement study -- model stage: the Ridge baseline on the 15-fold harness, the stop_aware target, and NNNC-style plain-LSTM regressors on three input sets
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2). Nothing is adopted by this stage; it selects the model the framework and sizer stages use.

nnp_ridge.role: baseline: NNPredict as is (point target, H=4, z>=1.0 & |pred|>=0.10 gate, class params, grace 2.6 h)

nnp_lstm_ind.change: LSTM_RAW regressor on NNPredict's inputs + raw8

nnp_lstm_ret.change: LSTM_RAW regressor on raw8 + lagged returns + gains

baseline_report: nnp_ridge pooled per half beside w_aro, cs_aro and st_g24_mom (judge_one(nnp_ridge, comparator), reported only -- no verdict is attached to the baseline)
instrument: per arm: a record for all 15 folds, model trained per fold on its training window (run_folds strict artefact check), and trades in both halves; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (no P&L read)
alone: judge_one(arm, nnp_ridge) with the rule maps below
selection_R7: the model arm (nnp_ridge, nnp_ridge_sa, nnp_lstm_raw, nnp_lstm_ind, nnp_lstm_ret) with the highest pooled total pp over f00-f14 among those whose judge_one halves vs nnp_ridge have no WORSENED verdict (nnp_ridge itself qualifies); ties -> nnp_ridge. An INCONCLUSIVE-instrument arm cannot be selected.
seed_robustness: constitution gate 5 applies to adoption, which this stage does not do; the selected model's later PASSes carry their own seed rule
seen_before: NNPredict memory (fit metrics decoupled from P&L; single-horizon H=4 best on its own 4/8-window walk-forwards)
no 15-fold harness result for any NNPredict class
a 30-day smoke run of NNPredict_LSTM_Raw on 2025-01 (pipeline check: 26 trades; trained and tested on the same window, not a result)
